connector.name: SiteGuardian
connector.registryDescription: EU-hosted website monitoring + 17-framework compliance MCP. One anonymous tool, four authenticated.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.siteguardian.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gweber account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api-key> — required for the four authenticated tools (list_monitored_domains, get_domain_status, get_drift_events, get_fix_recommendations). The scan_domain tool works anonymously without this header. Get a key at https://siteguardian.io/settings
